_about: Clothing fits per character body, in raw GLB (bind-pose) space: y up, +z = front. Authored from `node tools/measure_bodies.mjs <body>` silhouettes; re-check there after changing. tails: vertices behind zBelow within y are tail (clothes ignore them, the tail pokes through). top / bottom: the shirt's and shorts' height ranges. chest: where packs / sashes sit (straps find the arm sockets from the arm bones). verts: the GLB's vertex count — a mismatch means the model changed, so the fit is skipped (with a warning).
